FAQs
items.html:
Do I need a SmartHub if I already have the SmartBrush?
The SmartHub enhances your SmartBrush by providing UV sanitizing, drying, SmartMag wireless charging, and convenient storage, ensuring your brush stays clean, dry, and protected from germs, especially in bathrooms where brushes are commonly exposed to bacteria.
How does the UV sanitizing work?
The SmartHub uses advanced UV-C light to eliminate up to 99.9% of bacteria and microbes on your brush head in just minutes. Simply place your brush in the SmartHub after use, and it will sanitize it quickly while drying it continuously between uses.
Can I use water to clean the inside of the ULTIM8® SmartHub?
You can lightly dampen the microfiber cloth to assist with cleaning the inside of the SmartHub. However, avoid excessive water, as too much moisture inside the SmartHub can potentially damage the UV lights.
How often do I need to clean the SmartHub?
We recommend cleaning the SmartHub once a week. Unplug it, remove the bottom cover, and wipe down the inside. For best results, you can purchase the HubMate™ Microfiber Cleaning Tool, specially designed to clean the SmartHub and keep it in top condition.
Can I travel with the SmartHub?
While it’s possible to travel with the SmartHub, we recommend the Travel SmartCase™, specifically designed for on-the-go brushing. The Travel SmartCase offers UV sanitizing, SmartMag wireless charging, and custom storage compartments for your SmartBrush, toothpaste, and floss. It’s the ultimate solution for maintaining oral hygiene while traveling.
